basics.name: Rajarshi Sen
basics.description: I'm a passionate software engineer with a strong foundation in backend systems and a growing interest in Machine Learning. I'm currently pursuing my Masters in Computer Science, focusing on AI and ML. I enjoy building robust and scalable solutions, and I'm always looking for new challenges. In my free time, I'm an enthusiastic photographer.

highlights: Built and optimized the employee data synchronization pipeline, for seamless on boarding and regular data aggregation, from HRIS, ATS & OAuth systems providers.
Implemented attribute-based access control (ABAC) to enhance data privacy and ensure secure and scalable authorization at user and role levels.
Built user-management and role & user level access control configuration UI, in Clojurescript, and ReactJs.
As part of the services team: Developed a market research module for BloombergQuint (client), a leading financial news platform, which was later acquired by NDTV India.
As a part of the platform team, we built all backend services in Clojure and the UI in Typescript and ReactJs. I worked on and managed multiple microservices, like:
Bold: CMS, rich text news editor, content management system for digital news publishers
Sketches: public content delivery API & with dynamic caching

I handled multiple data migrations to onboard large customers, optimizing processes to transfer terabytes of sensitive data efficiently, and resolving bottlenecks to streamline read-write latencies in our existing systems.
Contributed to rebuilding 'Bold' the CMS platform (news publishing editor) frontend, using Typescript, ReactJs, and NodeJs.
Developed a self-scaling, bulk image import service using AWS Lambda, for on-ground photo journalists.

Led a team to design and implement our in-house Authentication service from scratch, along with a custom SSO implementation, for multi-domain customers. Using NodeJs, JWT, OAuth, PostgreSQL and a Redis Cache. Eventually serving a billion authentications and auth-verifications per month.
Recognized as the youngest engineer trusted with on-call duties & commended for mitigating critical production issues.
Earned early leadership opportunities as the youngest team lead, receiving appreciation for guiding and supporting peers.
